title: Delegating Authorization to Misaligned Agents: Coalitional Alignment and Safe Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.15803v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-running AI agents create a control problem: each action they take changes the state, which in turn affects the trajectory of future actions. If the agent is not fully aligned, then guaranteeing safety requires approving consequential actions before allowing them to be executed. But requiring human approval at every step makes attention a bottleneck. Delegating review to other AI agents raises the same alignment problem: the reviewers may themselves be misaligned. We identify a condition on a reviewing panel that is weaker than individual alignment yet necessary and sufficient for a guarantee that the principal fares at least as well in expectation as under a designated baseline policy.   Each reviewer agent reports whether an action proposal made by a proposer agent improves its own utility relative to the baseline. translated_title: 将授权委托给未对齐智能体：联盟对齐与安全控制
translated_abstract: 长期运行的AI智能体带来了一个控制问题：它们采取的每个动作都会改变环境状态，而状态变化又会影响后续动作的轨迹。如果智能体没有完全对齐，那么要保证安全，就需要在允许执行重要动作之前先对其加以批准。但若每一步都要求人类批准，人的注意力就会成为瓶颈。将审查工作委托给其他AI智能体又会引发同样的对齐问题：审查者本身也可能未对齐。我们识别出了审查委员会所需满足的一个条件，该条件弱于个体对齐，但对于保证委托人在期望意义上至少不差于某个指定基线策略而言，它是充分必要的。在该框架中，每个审查者智能体会报告提出者智能体所提交的动作提案是否相对基线改善了其自身效用。我们证明，一个容忍k次否决的阈值规则是安全的，当且仅当在移除任意k个审查者之后……（原文摘要至此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了“联盟对齐”这一新概念——识别出审查委员会所满足的一个弱于个体对齐的充要条件，证明在该条件下可以安全地将动作审批权委托给可能未对齐的AI审查者，通过容忍k次否决的阈值规则保证委托人的期望效用不劣于指定的基线策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the concept of "coalitional alignment," identifying a necessary and sufficient condition on a review panel—weaker than individual alignment—under which a threshold rule tolerating k disapprovals can safely delegate action approval to potentially misaligned AI reviewers, guaranteeing that the principal fares at least as well in expectation as under a designated baseline policy.
